name: Billing Tax Region 3
definition: Tax region that levies a tax on the services in a statement.

RegionNumber.name: Region Number
RegionNumber.definition: Specifies a particular unique zone of taxes assigned by taxing authorities. A tax region number is unique. Every account is considered to reside within a tax region, although some tax regions may not charge taxes on services.

RegionName.name: Region Name
RegionName.definition: Name associated with a specific tax region number.

CustomerTaxIdentification.name: Customer Tax Identification
CustomerTaxIdentification.definition: Specifies the financial institution’s customer tax identification number. ||Usage: |This is the number passed from the financial institution to the taxing authority to indicate the specific customer tied to the taxes calculated for this tax region and group of delivered services. It is typically the tax identification tied to a customer’s account.

PointDate.name: Point Date
PointDate.definition: Date on which the tax calculation was performed. ||Usage: |This date can be used to verify the tax rate value on the calculation date.

SendingFinancialInstitution.name: Sending Financial Institution
SendingFinancialInstitution.definition: Tax information that relates to the sending financial institution.

InvoiceNumber.name: Invoice Number
InvoiceNumber.definition: Unique number to be used by the customer to cross-reference between the tax region information and a tax invoice or notice.

MethodC.name: Method C
MethodC.definition: Tax values are based on tax calculation method C.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total tax amount expressed in the account’s settlement (or charging) currency. ||Usage: This total sums the individual service level taxes as calculated for each service by methods A, B and D. The sum of these amounts across all tax regions for the statement is displayed as the tax total sum in the compensation section.

TaxDueToRegion.name: Tax Due To Region
TaxDueToRegion.definition: Total amount of all taxes for a specific customer within the tax region expressed in the tax region’s host currency. ||Usage: It is the same value as total tax amount and is included for the specific use of tax calculation methods A, B and D.
